items.title: fix: let agents call tools on larger MCP servers in one step (#206977)
items.summary: fix: let agents call tools on larger MCP servers in one step (#206977) ## What Problem This Solves With several MCP servers installed, the system prompt lists MCP tools in a directory that is limited to 4,096 bytes. When not every tool input fits, whole servers keep their inputs, starting with the smallest. A tool on a larger server is then listed without its input. The agent must first look up the input with `tool_describe` or guess it, so the task takes an extra model round trip. ## User Impact On a larger MCP server, the agent can now call more tools in one step. Fewer requests are made per task, so tasks finish faster and cost less. The directory stays within 4,096 bytes and is identical on each turn, so prompt caching is not affected. ## Why This Change Was Made The directory removes descriptions first, and then turns the largest servers into count lines. This change keeps those steps. It then fills the space the listed names leave with inputs: the listed servers take turns, and each gives its shortest remaining input. Thus no listed server loses all its inputs because of its size or name. If every input fits, all inputs stay. The usage-ranked tool index lab is unchanged. ## Evidence A real `gpt-5.4-mini` run with 5 MCP servers and plain-language tasks. Each cell has 10 one-turn sessions, plus one 8-turn session. In each cell, the value before the arrow is `main`. The value after the arrow is this branch. | Fixture | First call correct | Calls per turn | Requests per turn | |---|---|---|---| | 5 servers (5-tool tracker + 4 x 15) | 9/10 -> 8/10 | 2.4 -> 1.7 | 3.0 -> 2.5 | | Needed tool on the 35-tool server | 2/10 -> 7/10 | 2.0 -> 1.6 | 3.0 -> 2.5 | | Same, `$ref` input schema | 0/10 -> 10/10 | 2.0 -> 1.5 | 3.0 -> 2.3 | | 5 servers, 8 turns | 6/8 -> 8/8 | 1.25 -> 1.0 | 2.25 -> 2.0 | | 35-tool server, 8 turns | 7/8 -> 8/8 | 1.13 -> 1.0 | 2.13 -> 2.0 | - In each session, the tool list was the same on every turn. - Directory size was 3,487-3,776 B on `main` and 4,045-4,088 B on this branch, so it stays within 4,096 B. - New tests in `tool-search-mcp-directory.test.ts` cover two cases: servers take turns for inputs, and the byte limit holds with an instruction row near the names limit. `agent-tools.prefix-stability.test.ts` passes. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: Character.AI擬拍賣用戶聊天紀錄，美國42名檢察長反對
items.summary: 美國加州及伊利諾州等42名檢察長周二（11/24）宣布，已聯手向破產法院提出異議，反對AI聊天機器人業者Character.AI於12月1日拍賣旗下平臺及逾2,100萬個美國用戶帳號的私人聊天紀錄，其中有超過210萬個帳號由未成年人註冊，且擬議交易並未提供任何用戶隱私保障措施。

items.title: WPIDE修補未經驗證遠端程式碼執行漏洞，未更新可能導致管理員遭誘使執行惡意PHP
items.summary: WordPress網站管理外掛WPIDE近日發布更新，修補高風險漏洞CVE-2026-124251。WPIDE整合檔案管理、程式碼編輯器及程式碼片段功能，讓管理者可直接在後臺修改網站檔案及加入自訂功能，目前已有逾4萬個啟用安裝，前述漏洞可能導致攻擊者利用跨網站請求偽造（CSRF）繞過防護，進而在伺服器執行任意程式碼，CVSS評分為8.8分。

items.title: 幣安解除63.4億美元數位資產竊案相關提款限制
items.summary: 幣安宣布10月資安事件後暫停的提款服務已完成復原，與該事件相關的提款限制全面解除。少數區塊鏈網路仍因維護或計畫升級暫停提款，幣安表示，受影響的提款量僅占日常流量極小比例，與此次資安事件的復原作業無關。

items.title: Drupal揭露已遭利用的安裝程式新漏洞
items.summary: 上週開源內容管理系統（CMS）Drupal修補與安裝程式有關的遠端程式碼執行（RCE）漏洞CVE-2026-132165（Fail2Install），近日傳出被用於實際攻擊，如今Drupal再度揭露安裝程式相關漏洞，成為資安圈的焦點。
